set(CMAKE_MACOSX_RPATH ON CACHE INTERNAL "enable MACOSX RPATH" FORCE)
set(ANTLR4CPP_JAR_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/antlr-4.13.2-complete.jar" "set Antlr4 Jar location")
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WITH_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ANTLR_BUILD_CPP_TESTS OFF CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(antlr4-4.13.2/runtime/Cpp)
